Name: Quick Info Menu - Gift Tastes - Calendar - Bundle Planner
Author: Field028
Description:
[center][/center]
[center][size=5][b][color=#E8913A][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55775/55775-1795244015-1581034593.png[/img][/color]
[/b][/size]
[left][size=5][b][color=#E8913A]Description[/color][/b][/size][/left]
[/center]
[left]Quick Info Menu adds new tabs to the game menu so you can check the things you usually alt-tab to the wiki for, without leaving the game. Gift tastes, festival details, bundle requirements and Robin's building costs are all one click away from the menu you already open every day.[/left]
[line]
[b][size=5][color=#E8913A]Installation instructions[/color][/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods (or install it with Vortex).[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b][size=5][color=#E8913A]Main features[/color][/size][/b]

[font=Arial][size=4][b][color=#F7C548]New menu tabs[/color][/b][/size][/font]
[list]
[*]Adds [b]Gift Tastes[/b], [b]Calendar[/b] and [b]Carpenter[/b] tabs to the game menu, right after the Social tab.[/*]
[*]Gift Tastes: who loves or likes what. Calendar: every season's birthdays and festivals. Carpenter: Robin's buildings and upgrades.[/*]
[*]Works like the game's own tabs.[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55775/55775-1795561364-1730787453.png[/img]

[b][size=4][color=#F7C548]Gift Tastes tab [/color][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Browse by villager to see every item they love, like, dislike and hate. [/*]
[*]Browse by item to see which villagers love or like it. [/*]
[*]Search by name, or filter to only items that someone loves or likes. [/*]
[*]Click any item to see how to get it (sources, seasons, recipes), based on the Stardew Valley Wiki.[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55775/55775-1795138721-1902402507.png[/img]

[size=4][b][color=#F7C548]Calendar tab [/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The real game calendar, with the original look and animations, for any season (use the arrows to switch). [/*]
[*]Click a festival to see the time, place, what to do, rewards and tips. [/*]
[*]Click a Bookseller day to see what the Bookseller sells. [/*]
[*]Click a villager's birthday to open their Gift Tastes. Press Esc to go back to the same calendar season. [/*]
[*]Also replaces the game's calendar wherever it opens (Pierre's board, UI Info Suite 2's calendar button).[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55775/55775-1795138679-588482416.png[/img]

[b][size=4][color=#F7C548]Bundles [/color][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Click any item on a Community Center bundle page to see how to get it.[/*]
[*]Bundle Planner: every bundle item in one list, with a tab for each season plus All Seasons. Open it from the tabs above the bundle page.[/*]
[*]Season and rain icons on each item show when you can get it, so you can see what you must collect before the season ends.[/*]
[*]Category dropdown: All Items, Crops, Forage, Fish, Animal Products, Artisan Goods, Cooking, Mining, Monster Loot, Resources, or Crafted & Special.[/*]
[*]Filters: Only in [season] (items you can’t get in any other season), Rain Only, and Show Donated. Your choices are remembered.[/*]
[*]Tick the items you already have. Ticks are saved and shared with every player in multiplayer.[/*]
[*]Bigger page arrows outside the bundle window.[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55775/55775-1795203678-1473089127.png[/img]

[size=4][b][color=#f7c548]Item Info[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]A magnifying-glass button left of the game menu opens a list of every item, modded items included.[/*]
[*]Browse by category, search everything, or check your backpack. Click an item to see what it is and how to get it.[/*]
[*]Press the [b]middle mouse button[/b] over any item to see the same info.[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55775/55775-1795554646-1133707008.png[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55775/55775-1795554651-1545502727.png[/img]

[b][size=4][color=#F7C548]Carpenter tab [/color] [/size][/b]
[list]
[*]All of Robin's farm buildings, house upgrades and renovations with costs, materials and building previews. [/*]
[*]Costs turn green or red depending on whether you can afford them right now.[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55775/55775-1795138755-555092969.png[/img]

[size=4][b][color=#F7C548]Festival reminders [/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]A small notice when a festival is today or tomorrow.[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55775/55775-1795138792-1535222623.png[/img]

[size=4][b][color=#F7C548]Tool upgrade buff [/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Shows Clint's tool upgrade as a buff icon with the days left, and a star when it is ready to pick up.[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55775/55775-1795138869-1064181147.png[/img]
[line]
[size=5][b][color=#E8913A]Requirements[/color] [/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[/list][b][size=4][color=#F7C548]Compatibility [/color][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Works with UI Info Suite 2. When it is installed, this mod hides its own Calendar tab and tool upgrade buff to avoid duplicates, and UI Info Suite 2's calendar button opens this mod's calendar.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer: each player who wants the tabs needs the mod installed.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4][color=#F7C548]Config[/color][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][color=#ffffff]Change settings in-game with Generic Mod Config Menu (optional).[/color][/*]
[*]Every feature can be turned on or off in config.json (created in the mod folder after the first run).[/*]
[/list][line]
[b][size=5][color=#E8913A]Shout outs[/color] [/size][/b]
[list]
[*]The Stardew Valley Wiki and its editors: all gift, item, festival and building data comes from the wiki.[/*]
[*]Pathoschild for SMAPI and the mod build tools.[/*]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Unzip into Stardew Valley/Mods. Requires SMAPI 4.0.0+.

Manifest.Name: Quick Info Menu
Manifest.Description: Adds Gift Tastes, Calendar and Carpenter tabs to the game menu, bundle item info and a Bundle season planner, plus Item Info: browse every item, or press a key over any item to see its info.
